programbench.task: rebuild 200 programs from scratch; model chooses the output language
programbench.artifacts: per-submission fork pinned in pointer.yaml with per-task submission.tar.gz (Hugging Face), eval.json, traj.json; registry _stats/score.json is per-test booleans; ignored_tests.json
programbench.verdict: Not importable under the current method: 0-2 fully passing tasks per model in supported languages, models write different languages on the same task, and there is no before-state. Needs owner decisions on a partial-credit outcome rule, a from-scratch size metric and a Rust analyzer.

swe_refactor_bench.verdict: Not importable: trajectories carry no final diff or snapshot (also none in github.com/Einsia/SWE-Refactor-Bench); tasks are mostly cross-language or build-system migrations.
